consistency_signal.rule: share UP >= strong -> bull 7; >= moderate -> bull 3; share DOWN >= strong -> bear 7; >= moderate -> bear 3

F3.direction: the stock's own reaction tendency; not affected by the variant
F3.history: last up to 8 earlier reactions (at least 4 required, else MISSING), next-session close-to-close, flat band 0.5 percent

F5.direction: positive values count toward bull in the continuation variant and toward bear in the contrarian variant; negative values the reverse

F7.otherwise: MISSING with the failing condition as reason
per_event_conditions: iv_rank row updated_at (when present) is not after the cutoff
snapshot status OK and captured inside the window
F7.recorded_not_applied: ratio of implied_move_perc to the mean absolute prior reaction is recorded for analysis only
F7.signal: option skew label of volatility/context captured in the window: call_rich -> bull 10, put_rich -> bear 10, flat -> available with 0 points
F7.variant_effect: none (the provider defined skew label is the same in both variants)
F7.verification_scope: verified on one liquid symbol (AAPL): volatility/context and interpolated-iv one year back, iv-rank stamped two years; thin names unverified, so a thin-name check in the first shadow week is an activation gate

sector.feature: sector ETF ret20 minus SPY ret20

F8.sector_map: symbol to sector SPDR from a frozen mapping file; an unmapped symbol has the sector sub-signal MISSING

approval: activation of any capture or scoring job needs the written approvals listed in section F of the shadow pilot design document

decision.BUY: bull >= 14 and bear <= 4 and bull - bear >= 10
decision.SELL: bear >= 14 and bull <= 4 and bear - bull >= 10
decision.threshold_origin: 14 = 35 percent of 40, 4 = 10 percent, margin 10 = 25 percent: declared from the design, not tuned on any outcome

evaluation.claims: no accuracy claim from the shadow period alone
evaluation.data: shadow predictions only, graded afterwards from earnings_event_outcomes (next-session close-to-close, flat band 0.5 percent)
evaluation.minimum_before_any_claim: at least 100 decided calls per variant over at least 8 earnings weeks, and the evidence audit passed; below that only descriptive reporting
report: BUY, SELL, NO_TRADE by UP, FLAT, DOWN matrices
strict and direction-only hit rates with Wilson intervals (z 1.96 and Bonferroni z 2.2414)
cost x0-x3 and slippage x1-x3 sensitivity
benchmarks: always BUY, always SELL, momentum sign, previous-reaction sign, coverage-matched random

event_eligibility.cutoff: earliest plausible release (event label nominal BMO 06:00 or AMC 16:00 America/New_York, or the SEC acceptance time if earlier) minus exactly 24 absolute hours, stored in UTC and America/New_York
event_eligibility.entry: market-on-close order at the base session close; the order deadline (10 minutes before that close) must be after the cutoff
event_eligibility.liquidity_gate: adv20 (20-session mean of close*volume) at least 20,000,000 USD, else NO_TRADE
event_eligibility.timing: EXPLORATORY_UNCERTAIN categories only (BMO with SEC acceptance before the open; AMC not contradicted); always labelled timing-uncertain
event_eligibility.window: capture and prediction between release minus 48 h and the cutoff; later predictions are out-of-window and excluded from evaluation

evidence_rules.freshness: a snapshot classified STALE_AGE is dropped (MISSING, reason STALE_AGE); LAST_SESSION_WEEKEND and LAST_SESSION_HOLIDAY evidence is used and labelled
evidence_rules.missing: missing evidence earns no points and does not count toward coverage; never neutral, never imputed
evidence_rules.priors: only reactions whose reaction close + 45 minutes precede the cutoff, recomputed from regular-session candles (never from provider move fields)
evidence_rules.suspect_windows: a close-to-close move above 25 percent on a session that is not a reaction session of the same symbol marks windows suspect; features whose window contains one are missing

factors.note: their evidence may be captured but contributes no points and no coverage; the 40-point score is never scaled to 100

outputs.per_prediction: bull_points, bear_points, weight_available, weight_max=40, coverage, per-factor breakdown with snapshot ids and missing reasons, reason codes, variant, prereg hash, config hash
outputs.scaling: FORBIDDEN: the partial score is never scaled to 100

purpose: Initial 40-point Smart Move scoring version. SHADOW ONLY: no live signal, nothing shown to trading, no order. Prospective evaluation only: no historical, validation or test data of the baseline study is opened or used.

sealing.baseline_validation_and_test: remain sealed and are not used for this version
sealing.historical_backtest: not performed for this version (inputs lack point-in-time proof)

variants.continuation: price and market directional sub-signals point in the direction of the move
variants.contrarian: the same sub-signals with BUY and SELL swapped
variants.rule: both variants are recorded for every event in parallel; neither is chosen as winner; direction is never flipped after seeing shadow results; Bonferroni (2 variants) applies to their intervals
